keep: Leave blank to keep the stored one.

reasons.host: Enter a host name or address, without scheme, port or path.
reasons.timezone: Choose a time zone of the list.
reasons.unknown: This setting is not part of this kind of server.
reasons.secret: This setting is a secret and is sent apart.

choices.optional: Use explicit FTP over TLS if available

notes.explicit: Starts in clear text and upgrades with AUTH TLS before signing in; a server that does not offer TLS is refused. The first time, its certificate is shown for you to confirm.
notes.implicit: Speaks TLS from the first byte, usually on port 990. The first time, the server's certificate is shown for you to confirm.

warnings.optional: If the server does not offer TLS, or someone on the network removes the offer, the password and the files go in clear text without a warning. Prefer requiring TLS.
warnings.plain: FTP sends the password and the files without encryption. Use TLS if the server offers it.

notes.anonymous: Signs in as anonymous with no secret saved, as public servers expect. An SFTP server is first asked to let it in without authentication.
notes.ask: No password is saved. It is asked for when connecting and kept only in the server's memory for your session.
notes.interactive: No secret is saved. Whatever the server asks when connecting, the password or a one-time code, is asked to you then and never kept.
notes.account: Some older FTP servers ask for an account after the password (ACCT). It is kept in the vault like the password.

password.label: Password
password.keep: Leave blank to keep the existing password.

account.label: Account
account.keep: Leave blank to keep the existing account.

list_timezone.label: Server time zone
list_timezone.hint: The time zone the server lists times in. Most servers use UTC.

charset.label: Character set of file names
charset.hint: Change it only for old servers that show accents wrong; most servers use UTF-8.

proxy_kind.label: Proxy
proxy_kind.hint: Tunnels the connection through a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy instead of connecting directly.

jump_host.label: Jump host
jump_host.hint: Tunnels the SSH connection through this server first, as ssh -J does. Leave the host blank to connect directly.
